item.title: Sri Lanka Trials Electric Passenger Drone
item.description: Sri Lanka has successfully conducted its first official trial of an electric-powered passenger drone, the Chinese-made EHang E216, at Colombo Port City. Aviation Minister Anura Karunatilaka participated in the flight, marking a significant step towards future commercial drone services in the country.
item.author: news@rediff.co.in (Rediff News Desk)

item.title: Interstate AI Extortion Gang Busted In Jhalawar
item.description: Jhalawar Police have dismantled an interstate syndicate that used AI tools and digital arrest traps to extort money, leading to the suicide of a 56-year-old woman. Six individuals, including four women from Bihar, have been apprehended, and three minors detained, following an extensive investigation that traced the gang 1,500 km away.
item.author: news@rediff.co.in (Rediff News Desk)
